mapper.sql: SELECT i.pantry_item_id AS item_id, l.lot_id, i.account_id, i.patient_id, i.food_item_id, l.on_hand_quantity AS on_hand, l.reserved_quantity AS reserved, i.unit_code, i.state_code, l.expire_at, l.lot_code FROM pantry_lot l JOIN pantry_item i ON i.pantry_item_id = l.pantry_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pantry_item (pantry_item_id, account_id, patient_id, food_item_id, state_code, unit_code, created_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{accountId}, #{patientId}, #{foodItemId}, #{stateCode}, #{unitCode}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO pantry_lot (lot_id, pantry_item_id, lot_code, on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity, expire_at, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{lotId}, #{itemId}, #{lotCode}, #{onHand}, #{reserved}, #{expireAt}, 1, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND i.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY l.lot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pantry_reservation (reservation_id, plan_version_id, lot_id, quantity, status_code, created_at) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{planVersionId}, #{lotId}, #{quantity}, 1, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT plan_version_id, lot_id, quantity FROM pantry_reservation WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} AND status_code = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pantry_reservation SET status_code = 2 WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pantry_change_event WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pantry_change_event (event_id, patient_id, lot_id, change_type_code, quantity, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{patientId}, #{lotId}, #{changeTypeCode}, #{quantity}, #{createdAt})
